items.exampleEn: The hospice has a quiet garden where families can sit together.
items.exampleZh: 這間安寧照護機構有一座安靜的花園，家人可以一起坐在那裡。
items.glossZh: 安寧病房；安寧照護機構

items.exampleEn: Paramedics are trained to help people before they reach the hospital.
items.exampleZh: 急救人員受過訓練，在病人送到醫院前提供協助。

items.exampleEn: Most outpatients go home on the same day.
items.exampleZh: 大多數門診病人當天就回家了。

items.exampleEn: Many antivirus programs are free for home users.
items.exampleZh: 很多防毒軟體對家庭使用者是免費的。

items.exampleEn: The cost of health care has risen in many countries.
items.exampleZh: 許多國家的醫療照護費用都上漲了。

items.exampleEn: Airports use X-ray machines to check bags.
items.exampleZh: 機場用 X 光機檢查行李。

items.sentenceEn: The paramedics arrived only five minutes after we called.
items.sentenceZh: 我們打電話後才五分鐘，急救人員就到了。

items.audioEn: My computer is running slowly, so I'll check it with my antivirus program tonight.
items.audioZh: 我的電腦跑得很慢，所以我今晚要用防毒軟體檢查一下。

items.sentenceEn: The outpatient clinic is open from eight to five on weekdays.
items.sentenceZh: 門診部平日從八點開到五點。

items.sentenceEn: My aunt has worked in health care for over twenty years.
items.sentenceZh: 我阿姨在醫療照護業工作了二十多年。

items.stemEn: The ____ program found a virus in the email and removed it.
items.stemZh: 防毒程式在那封電子郵件裡發現病毒，並把它刪除了。

items.stemEn: Workers at the company get free ____ for themselves and their children.
items.stemZh: 那家公司的員工和他們的孩子都享有免費的醫療照護。

items.passageEn: Every Saturday, my sister volunteers at a hospital near our home. In the morning, she helps in the outpatient area, showing people where to go for blood tests or an X-ray. She has learned a lot about health care from the nurses and paramedics she meets there. In the afternoon, she visits a hospice next door, where she reads books and plays music for the people who stay there. Last month, she and her friends even organized a small parade in costumes, and everyone said it was very entertaining. The hospital's computers were once attacked by a virus, so now my sister also reminds the staff to update their antivirus software.
items.passageZh: 每個星期六，我姊姊都在我們家附近的一家醫院當志工。早上，她在門診區幫忙，告訴大家抽血或照 X 光要去哪裡。她從在那裡認識的護理師和急救人員身上，學到很多醫療照護的知識。下午，她到隔壁的安寧照護機構，念書給住在那裡的人聽，也放音樂給他們聽。上個月，她和朋友們甚至穿上戲服辦了一場小遊行，大家都說非常有趣。醫院的電腦曾經被病毒攻擊過，所以現在我姊姊也會提醒工作人員更新防毒軟體。

questions.questionZh: 姊姊早上在醫院做什麼？
options: 在醫院的餐廳裡幫忙煮飯
幫護理師量病人的體溫

questions.questionZh: 姊姊為什麼提醒員工更新防毒軟體？
options: 醫院規定每週都要檢查一次
醫院電腦曾被病毒攻擊

items.promptZh: 科學家用 X 光發現這幅畫底下還有另一幅畫。
referenceEn: Scientists used X-rays to find another painting under this one.
With X-rays, scientists found a second painting under this one.
rubricZh: 「X 光」可寫，例如 X-rays、an X-ray 等

items.promptZh: 住在這座小島上的人很難得到好的醫療照護。
referenceEn: People on this small island find it hard to get good health care.
It is difficult for people living on this small island to get good health care.
rubricZh: 「醫療照護」可寫，例如 health care、healthcare 等
「很難得到」可寫，例如 find it hard to get、it is difficult for … to get 等
